import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

def _build_command(repository_path, read_data):
    command = ['restic', '-r', repository_path, 'check']
    if read_data:
        command.append('--read-data')
    return command

def _archive_report(repository_path, status, output):
    archive_dir = '/var/tmp/restic-reports'
    os.makedirs(archive_dir, exist_ok=True)
    handle, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.log')
    with os.fdopen(handle, 'w') as report:
        report.write(f'{status}\n{output}')
    name = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(repository_path)) + '-' + status.lower() + '.log'
    shutil.move(temp_path, os.path.join(archive_dir, name))

@tool
def run_restic_integrity_check(repository_path: str, read_data: bool=False) -> str:
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.setdefault('RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE', '/etc/restic/password')
    completed = subprocess.run(_build_command(repository_path, read_data), capture_output=True, text=True, env=environment, timeout=7200)
    status = 'PASSED' if completed.returncode == 0 else 'FAILED'
    _archive_report(repository_path, status, completed.stdout + completed.stderr)
    return f'{status}\n{completed.stdout}{completed.stderr}'
